pr_title: Various follow-up: Fix build and EINVAL for _INVALID enum value
pr_body:
Please double check that I did not break compatibility, since this was specified in commit 2d93c20e:
> This does not touch anything exposed in src/systemd. Changing the defines there would be a compatibility break.

Fixes #18639.
pr_comments:
> Please double check that I did not break compatibility, since this was specified in commit [2d93c20](https://github.com/systemd/systemd/commit/2d93c20e5f600a9f1e4b617123577acf6ce5faa0):

issue_context.title: build failure if building with -Ddns-over-tls=openssl
issue_context.body:
**systemd version the issue has been seen with**
master 

**Expected behaviour you didn't see**
 clean build

**Unexpected behaviour you saw**
 build fails

**Steps to reproduce the problem**
 build systemd with -Dopenssl=true -Ddns-over-tls=openssl

**Additional program output to the terminal or log subsystem illustrating the issue**

```
In file included from ../../../src/systemd/src/basic/io-util.h:10,
                 from ../../../src/systemd/src/resolve/resolved-dnstls-openssl.c:11:
../../../src/systemd/src/resolve/resolved-dnstls-openssl.c: In function ‘SSL_freep’:
../../../src/systemd/src/basic/macro.h:412:28: error: void value not ignored as it ought to be
  412 |                         *p = func(*p);                          \
      |                            ^
../../../src/systemd/src/resolve/resolved-dnstls-openssl.c:16:1: note: in expansion of macro ‘DEFINE_TRIVIAL_CLEANUP_FUNC’
   16 | DEFINE_TRIVIAL_CLEANUP_FUNC(SSL*, SSL_free);
      | ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
../../../src/systemd/src/resolve/resolved-dnstls-openssl.c: In function ‘BIO_freep’:
../../../src/systemd/src/basic/macro.h:412:28: warning: assignment to ‘BIO *’ {aka ‘struct bio_st *’} from ‘int’ makes pointer from integer without a cast [-Wint-conversion]
  412 |                         *p = func(*p);                          \
      |                            ^
../../../src/systemd/src/resolve/resolved-dnstls-openssl.c:17:1: note: in expansion of macro ‘DEFINE_TRIVIAL_CLEANUP_FUNC’
   17 | DEFINE_TRIVIAL_CLEANUP_FUNC(BIO*, BIO_free);
      | ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```

Seems to be caused by https://github.com/systemd/systemd/commit/fd421c4adc7406de02e03e2f7ceede2cc6e1d9d4 ,
it looks like resolved-dnstls-openssl.c was not updated.

This patch fixes the issue for me:
```
diff --git a/src/resolve/resolved-dnstls-openssl.c b/src/resolve/resolved-dnstls-openssl.c
index defddb5237..17af90d4cc 100644
--- a/src/resolve/resolved-dnstls-openssl.c
+++ b/src/resolve/resolved-dnstls-openssl.c
@@ -13,8 +13,8 @@
 #include "resolved-dnstls.h"
 #include "resolved-manager.h"

-DEFINE_TRIVIAL_CLEANUP_FUNC(SSL*, SSL_free);
-DEFINE_TRIVIAL_CLEANUP_FUNC(BIO*, BIO_free);
+DEFINE_TRIVIAL_CLEANUP_FUNC_FULL(SSL*, SSL_free, NULL);
+DEFINE_TRIVIAL_CLEANUP_FUNC_FULL(BIO*, BIO_free, NULL);

 static int dnstls_flush_write_buffer(DnsStream *stream) {
         ssize_t ss;
```

However as I have no idea about crypto stuff I'm hesitant to PR this fix.

review_comments:
uh, hm, so this is problematic conceptually (though not in practice). PotableChangeType can be negative or positive, and we pick a _PORTABLE_CHANGE_TYPE_INVALID value really far away from the valid cases to ensure they don't conflict...

now in practice this doesn't matter, since EINVAL is 22, i.e. they do *not* conflict, but we should probably make this explicit, by mapping all negative values here explicitly, so that the compiler notices any collision
sorry, actually it's more complicated... where we store PortableChangeType we can also store any errno actually, and suddenly it's even more messy
